visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman sit on a grey couch in front of a light wood panel wall. The woman in a white t-shirt with a cartoon graphic is on the phone, looking agitated, while the man next to her, also in a white t-shirt, scrolls through his phone smiling. The woman hangs up aggressively and slams her phone down. (2) A rapid series of jump cuts shows the woman asking questions with exaggerated facial expressions (eyes wide, mouth open) while the man responds calmly, pointing to various items or his phone. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The scene shifts to the man holding a large cardboard box and a blue package of Moony diapers. A young boy in a light blue t-shirt appears, pointing his finger upwards. (4) Screen captures of a mobile shopping interface are shown, displaying product listings for diapers and milk powder with red prices and discount labels. (5) The man and the boy are shown unboxing the large cardboard box, pulling out cans of milk powder. The man looks directly at the camera giving a thumbs up. (6) The final scene shows the man sitting alone on the couch, heavily bandaged around his head and arm, holding a mug with a weary expression. Text overlays appear at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in an irritated, high-pitched tone, followed by the percussive sound of a phone being slammed. An upbeat, medium-tempo BGM with synthetic textures starts immediately. (2) A series of rapid-fire dialogue ensues; the female voice asks sharp, questioning phrases while the male voice responds with calm, steady delivery. Each transition is punctuated by a subtle 'whoosh' or 'pop' sound effect. (3) A child's voice enters briefly with a high-arousal exclamation. (4) The male narrator's voice becomes more promotional, explaining app features over a continuous rhythmic BGM track. (5) In the final phase, the upbeat music cuts abruptly to a sentimental, slow-tempo male ballad (Mandarin). The male voice changes to a weak, strained, and comedic tone, matching his injured visual appearance.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic advertisement for the Coupang shopping app, specifically highlighting its 'Rocket Delivery' speed and membership benefits. It uses a relatable domestic scenario of a wife testing her husband's attentiveness to prove the app's reliability for urgent baby supplies.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the app interface, brand names (Coupang, Moony, Meiji), and detailed explanation of promotional offers and delivery services.
